acquisition_method.evidence: The mass spectrometer was operated in data-dependent mode, automatically switching between MS and MS/MS acquisition for the 16 most abundant ion peaks per MS spectrum.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: modifications: monohydroxylated residue; acetylated residue; iodoacetamide derivatized residue

cleavage_agent.evidence: After trypsin digestion, N-terminally blocked peptides were enriched by Strong Cation Echange (SCX) as such peptides will not bind to the SCX resin at low pH.

collision_energy.evidence: The 16 most intense ions above a threshold value of 13,000 were isolated (window of 1.5 Th) for fragmentation at a normalized collision energy of 28% after filling the trap at a target value of 100,000 for maximum 80 ms.

enrichment_method.evidence: SCX enrichment of N-terminal peptides from Naa80 WT and KO cells was performed as described previously (PMID: 28315243).

fragmentation_method.evidence: The 16 most intense ions above a threshold value of 13,000 were isolated (window of 1.5 Th) for fragmentation at a normalized collision energy of 28% after filling the trap at a target value of 100,000 for maximum 80 ms.

ionization_type.evidence: The instrument setting was set to ESI-QUAD.

mass_analyzer.evidence: Full-scan MS spectra (375-1500 m/z) were acquired at a resolution of 60,000 in the orbitrap analyser after accumulation to a target value of 3,000,000.
